A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same INSPECTOR study. All 27 pages, including equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–K, support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original probing evaluations, pooling/classifier ablations, data-filtering experiments, cross-dataset transfer, and AlpacaEval 2.0 results.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including the main experiments and supplementary evaluations in Appendices F–J.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Appendix B retain the same annotation, representation extraction, pooling, feature construction, layer selection, and classifier-training procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate GSM8K, MATH, GPQA, and AlpacaEval 2.0. The cross-dataset transfer scenarios in Appendix G and downstream data-filtering tasks are also unchanged.

E2.justification: Tables 10 and 13 retain the same prompting, Qwen3-0.6B fine-tuning, and RoBERTa comparators. Section 5.2 retains DeepSeek-V3 and random filtering as the SFT comparison methods.

E3.justification: Dataset splits, probing sample construction, model configurations, score threshold, PCA dimensionality, cross-validation, evaluation metrics, and SFT settings are unchanged in Section 4.1 and Appendices C–E.

E4.justification: Both retain the pooling/classifier ablation, layer-wise diagnostics, cross-dataset robustness analysis, and GSM8K case study in Sections 5–6 and Appendices G, I, and J.

E5.justification: Appendix B retains the same definitions of means and standard deviations across cross-validation folds. Table 6 retains the same random-state settings, with no changes to uncertainty or repeated-run reporting.

E6.justification: The numerical entries in Tables 10–13, plotted results in Figures 3–9, and case-study scores in Appendix J are identical. No result entries or qualitative findings are added, removed, or corrected.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(6) and Appendix B's mathematical definitions are unchanged. No assumptions, derivations, formal results, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same Semantic Capacity Asymmetry Hypothesis, INSPECTOR contributions, and claims about evaluation quality and efficient data filtering.

C2.justification: Interpretations of latent evaluative signals, model scaling, data quality, and transferability are unchanged. Appendix A retains the same limitations concerning evaluation aspects, task coverage, and reliance on DeepSeek-V3.

D1.justification: The page 10 reproducibility statement changes from promising release upon acceptance to reporting that data and code have been released, with an explicit repository link. That link already appeared in v1's abstract; implementation details and prompt templates remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works, Section 2 discussion, and novelty positioning are unchanged. The added conference-publication header does not revise the relationship to prior research.

P1.justification: v2 adds the ICLR 2026 publication header and revises the release-status sentence. The remaining prose, terminology, section organization, and appendix structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: v2 adds a recurring publication header, updates the arXiv margin stamp, and slightly reflows page 10. Figures, tables, captions, and appendix prompt images retain their content and design.

improvement.justification: v2 resolves inconsistent release messaging: v1's abstract said code and data were available, while its reproducibility statement promised a future release. This provides a small improvement in documentation clarity. Scientific evidence is unchanged, and the PDFs do not establish that additional resources became available.
